subject: Request to delay live showcase for prompt validation and Asia travel conflict
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Satoshi Yamada <satoshi@yokohama-retail.com>, Naoko Ito <naoko@yokohama-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Request to delay live showcase for prompt validation and Asia travel conflict

Hi Satoshi / Naoko,

Quick note — I need to request a short postponement of our live showcase currently booked for Friday, 29 May. Two items came up that make the original slot risky for success:

1) I have an unavoidable international travel window that overlaps the final dry run on Thursday night PDT / Friday morning JST. The flight itinerary was changed yesterday and I won't be on reliable Wi‑Fi during the critical prep window.

2) Our technical dry run flagged a prompt-set alignment issue and a mismatch in the sample payload ordering. Marissa and the product team want an extra 48 hours to run workload traces against the customer's sample traces and validate the prompt sets end‑to‑end (we found a corner case for tokenization in one of the SKU descriptions).

We want to avoid a rushed demo that could surface data/format issues in front of your procurement and ops teams. Proposed options:
- Move to Monday 1 June (APAC-friendly window midday JST) — preferred
- Keep Friday 29 May but shift to a later time so I can join after my flight (riskier)
- Push to Tuesday 2 June and include an extended Q&A + runbook walkthrough

Action items from our side if we shift: Marissa will validate the sample_schema_v2.csv against our ingest pipeline and share a short runbook (attached: redwood_runbook_v1.pdf). Jordan will provision a temporary SSO test account so you can confirm access before the demo.

Please let us know which option works for you and any hard constraints on your side (procurement sign‑off windows, exec availability, etc.). Apologies for the disruption — want to make sure the demo represents a production‑ready experience.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales — Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0138

Attachments: redwood_runbook_v1.pdf (runbook), sample_schema_v2.csv (sample schema)
From: Satoshi Yamada <satoshi@yokohama-retail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naoko Ito <naoko@yokohama-retail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 23:03:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Request to delay live showcase for prompt validation and Asia travel conflict

Karthik —

Thanks for the heads up and the clear options. We prefer not to push past the first week of June because our budget committee meets the week of the 8th and we hoped a demo within the next 7–10 days would help. That said, we absolutely prefer a clean demo over a rushed one.

Option 1 (Mon 1 Jun) or Option 3 (Tue 2 Jun with extended Q&A) both work for our execs — Monday is slightly better. Can you confirm a JST time window between 10:00–13:00 JST? Naoko will coordinate procurement availability.

Also: are there any specific fields in the sample_schema_v2.csv you need filled out (customer IDs, SKU hierarchy, anonymized sales traces)? We can provide anonymized traces by Wednesday morning JST if that helps.

Best,
Satoshi
Digital Transformation Lead
Yokohama Retail Co., Ltd.
satoshi@yokohama-retail.com

Subject: Re: Request to delay live showcase for prompt validation and Asia travel conflict

Hi Satoshi / Naoko —

Thanks for the quick reply and for offering to share anonymized traces — that will help a lot. Confirming the plan:

- New demo slot: Monday, 1 June 2026 at 11:00 JST (which is Sunday 31 May 19:00 PDT). Please confirm if 11:00 JST is good and we will send a calendar invite.
- Deliverables before demo: Yokohama to share anonymized sample traces + a small CSV mapping file (customer_id -> sku_hierarchy) by Wednesday 28 May 09:00 JST. Jordan: please provision the SSO test account and send credentials by the same time.
- Runbook + checklist: attached is redwood_runbook_v1.pdf (short checklist). We will validate tokenization and run 3 workload traces against the sample data; any issues will be flagged to Naoko by EOD Thursday JST.
- Zoom + recording: we will include a recording and the runbook link in the calendar invite.

If anything changes on your side, please raise it ASAP. We're aiming to have the full run complete Thursday PDT so Monday's demo is fully polished.

Thanks again for being flexible — looking forward to the session.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Product Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
